titleEn: The Grass Is Taller Than Me

pages.text: Summer grass grew and grew, taller than Yuki. Wild raspberries ripened beyond the grass.
"I'll pick raspberries." Yuki stood before the tall grass with a basket.
Inside was dark. Yuki could see nothing. "What might be in there?"
Momo slipped into the grass. It parted with a rustle. Yuki could not move their feet.
"I'll go around." Yuki walked along the edge.
A long trail of trampled grass followed Yuki. The grassy patch kept going and going.
Looking down, Yuki saw the stream below. The raspberries were far away. "I'm farther away now!"
Grandma parted the grass with one hand. A narrow path appeared between it.
Yuki parted it with both hands. A dirt path appeared underfoot. "There was a path!"
Beyond the grass were lots of raspberries. Yuki picked a handful and ate them. Their mouth was prettily stained.
